component.name: rettui
component.summary: Reticulum client: LXMF messaging, NomadNet browsing and RRC chat

description.p: rettui talks over Reticulum, without servers: on your local network, by radio, or over the internet through entry points people run. It sends and receives LXMF messages, browses and hosts NomadNet pages, and joins RRC chat rooms. This is its web UI in a window of its own.
